title: The Soother Pack
blurb: Petra looks for the soother that fell into Dragon Land, and finds a small dragon instead.

endings.2: happy: Petra finds the soother in Mango's cave
endings.3: sad: Petra waits, but the soother does not come back

beats.ch01.s01.b001: A small blue cottage with a red door. Sunflowers nod in the breeze.
beats.ch01.s01.b003: Today I will find the soother.
beats.ch02.s01.b001: A warm cave full of shiny stones. A small fire crackles.
beats.ch02.s01.b004: You had the soother all along.
beats.ch03.s01.b001: The garden is quiet. One sunflower leans towards the window.
beats.ch03.s01.b004: The soother hums softly in her pocket.
